第1行（所选荧光/标记策略 + 透明方法）：**[NeuN + Alexa Fluor 647（胞体）, β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647（轴突/树突）, TO-PRO-3（全脑核染）] + iDISCO+（DBE RI匹配）**  
选择理由：iDISCO+ 适用于完整成年小鼠全脑（~10×8×6 mm）快速高透明化与光片成像；有机溶剂脱水/脱脂后透明度高、纤维束走行对比好；TO-PRO-3 与 Alexa Fluor 647 在iDISCO+流程中信号相对稳健，适合全脑三维神经元胞体与神经突起形态图谱构建。

**Protocol Steps：**

english.text:
Line 1 (Selected Fluorescence/Labeling Strategy + Clearing Method): **[NeuN + Alexa Fluor 647 (Soma), β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647 (Axons/Dendrites), TO-PRO-3 (Whole-brain nuclear stain)] + iDISCO+ (DBE RI matching)**
Rationale: iDISCO+ is suitable for rapid high-transparency clearing and light-sheet imaging of the whole adult mouse brain (~10×8×6 mm); high transparency and good contrast for fiber tract trajectories are achieved after organic solvent dehydration/delipidation; TO-PRO-3 and Alexa Fluor 647 signals are relatively robust in the iDISCO+ workflow, making it suitable for constructing 3D morphological maps of neuronal somata and neurites in the whole brain.

第1行（所选荧光/标记策略 + 透明方法）：**[NeuN + Alexa Fluor 647（胞体）, β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647（轴突/树突）, TO-PRO-3（全脑核染）] + iDISCO+（DBE RI匹配）**

**Protocol Steps：**

Rationale for selection: iDISCO+ is suitable for rapid high-transparency clearing and light-sheet imaging of the complete adult mouse whole brain (~10×8×6 mm); high transparency and good contrast for fiber tract trajectories are achieved after organic solvent dehydration/delipidation; TO-PRO-3 and Alexa Fluor 647 signals are relatively robust in the iDISCO+ workflow, making them suitable for constructing 3D morphological maps of whole-brain neuronal somata and neurites.

source.text:
第1行（所选荧光/标记策略 + 透明方法）：**[NeuN + Alexa Fluor 647（胞体）, β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647（轴突/树突）, TO-PRO-3（全脑核染）] + iDISCO+（DBE RI匹配）**  
选择理由：iDISCO+ 适用于完整成年小鼠全脑（~10×8×6 mm）快速高透明化与光片成像；有机溶剂脱水/脱脂后透明度高、纤维束走行对比好；TO-PRO-3 与 Alexa Fluor 647 在iDISCO+流程中信号相对稳健，适合全脑三维神经元胞体与神经突起形态图谱构建。

**Protocol Steps：**

english.text:
Line 1 (Selected Fluorescence/Labeling Strategy + Clearing Method): **[NeuN + Alexa Fluor 647 (Soma), β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647 (Axons/Dendrites), TO-PRO-3 (Whole-brain nuclear stain)] + iDISCO+ (DBE RI matching)**
Rationale for selection: iDISCO+ is suitable for rapid high-transparency clearing and light-sheet imaging of the whole adult mouse brain (~10×8×6 mm); after organic solvent dehydration/delipidation, transparency is high and fiber tract contrast is good; TO-PRO-3 and Alexa Fluor 647 signals are relatively robust in the iDISCO+ workflow, making them suitable for constructing 3D morphological maps of whole-brain neuronal somata and neurites.

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato (内源荧光), β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor (647)]
**Justification:** FDISCO（Fluorescence-preserved 3D Imaging of Solvent-Cleared Organs）是基于有机溶剂的快速透明方法，全脑透明可在约2天内完成，满足"尽快成像"的需求，且相比iDISCO+/uDISCO对荧光蛋白保护更佳（低温+碱性条件抑制荧光淬灭），已有文献证明可良好保留tdTomato内源信号。FDISCO使用THF脱水/脱脂后以BABB作为RI匹配液（RI≈1.56），与光片显微镜兼容，可接受一定程度的组织收缩（FDISCO收缩率约35–40%，均匀收缩不影响投射追踪）。标记策略：①保留tdTomato内源荧光追踪长程投射神经元；②在透明前对固定脑进行全脑免疫染色（iDISCO-style whole-mount），使用抗β-III Tubulin（TUJ1）抗体 + Alexa Fluor 647二抗标记轴突骨架结构，Alexa Fluor 647在有机溶剂中稳定性优异。两通道（tdTomato ~590 nm；AF647 ~647 nm）光谱分离良好，适合双通道光片成像。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

english.text:
**Chosen Method:** FDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato (endogenous fluorescence), β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor (647)]
**Justification:** FDISCO (Fluorescence-preserved 3D Imaging of Solvent-Cleared Organs) is a rapid clearing method based on organic solvents. Whole-brain clearing can be completed in approximately 2 days, meeting the requirement for "imaging as soon as possible." It offers better protection of fluorescent proteins compared to iDISCO+/uDISCO (low temperature + alkaline conditions inhibit fluorescence quenching), and literature has demonstrated that it can well preserve endogenous tdTomato signals. FDISCO uses THF for dehydration/de-lipidation and BABB as the RI matching medium (RI ≈ 1.56), which is compatible with light-sheet microscopy and accepts a certain degree of tissue shrinkage (FDISCO shrinkage rate is approximately 35–40%; uniform shrinkage does not affect projection tracing). Labeling strategy: ① Preserve endogenous tdTomato fluorescence to trace long-range projection neurons; ② Perform whole-brain immunostaining (iDISCO-style whole-mount) on the fixed brain prior to clearing, using anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) antibody + Alexa Fluor 647 secondary antibody to label axonal skeleton structures. Alexa Fluor 647 has excellent stability in organic solvents. The two channels (tdTomato ~590 nm; AF647 ~647 nm) have good spectral separation, suitable for dual-channel light-sheet imaging.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

source.text: **1 样品预处理（Post-fixation wash）**

english.text: **1 Sample Pre-treatment (Post-fixation wash)**

source.text: 1.1 将已4% PFA固定的成年小鼠全脑置于1× PBS中充分漂洗，去除残余固定液。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 × 1 hour)

english.text: 1.1 Place the adult mouse whole brain, already fixed in 4% PFA, in 1× PBS for thorough washing to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 × 1 hour)

source.text: **2 全脑免疫染色前渗透处理**

english.text: **2 Pre-permeabilization for Whole-Brain Immunostaining**

source.text: 2.1 将脑组织置于含0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100的1× PBS（PBST）中振荡渗透。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

english.text: 2.1 Place the brain tissue in 1× PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST) for oscillating permeabilization. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

source.text: 2.2 更换新鲜PBST继续渗透。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

english.text: 2.2 Replace with fresh PBST and continue permeabilization. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
**3 Blocking**

source.text: 3.1 将脑组织置于封闭液（5% (vol/vol) 正常驴血清 + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 0.1% (wt/vol) NaN₃ in 1× PBS）中振荡封闭。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

english.text: 3.1 Place the brain tissue in blocking solution (5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 0.1% (wt/vol) NaN₃ in 1× PBS) for oscillating blocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

source.text: **4 一抗孵育（β-III Tubulin / TUJ1）**

english.text: **4 Primary Antibody Incubation (β-III Tubulin / TUJ1)**

source.text: 4.1 将脑组织置于含抗β-III Tubulin（TUJ1）兔多克隆抗体（1:500稀释于封闭液）的溶液中，轻柔振荡孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

english.text: 4.1 Place the brain tissue in a solution containing anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) rabbit polyclonal antibody (diluted 1:500 in blocking solution) and incubate with gentle oscillation. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

source.text: 4.2 用PBST洗涤，去除未结合一抗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

english.text: 4.2 Wash with PBST to remove unbound primary antibody. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

source.text: **5 二抗孵育（Alexa Fluor 647）**

english.text: **5 Secondary Antibody Incubation (Alexa Fluor 647)**

source.text: 5.1 将脑组织置于含驴抗兔 Alexa Fluor 647二抗（1:500稀释于封闭液）的溶液中，避光振荡孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

english.text: 5.1 Place the brain tissue in a solution containing donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 secondary antibody (diluted 1:500 in blocking solution) and incubate with oscillation protected from light. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

source.text: 5.2 用PBST洗涤，去除未结合二抗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

english.text: 5.2 Wash with PBST to remove unbound secondary antibody. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

source.text: 5.3 用1× PBS终洗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

english.text: 5.3 Final wash with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

source.text: **6 脱水（THF梯度脱水）**

english.text: **6 Dehydration (THF Gradient Dehydration)**

source.text: 6.1 将脑组织置于50% (vol/vol) THF（四氢呋喃）水溶液（用NaOH调pH至9–10，以保护荧光蛋白）中振荡脱水。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

english.text: 6.1 Place the brain tissue in 50% (vol/vol) THF (tetrahydrofuran) aqueous solution (adjusted to pH 9–10 with NaOH to protect fluorescent proteins) for oscillating dehydration. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

source.text: 6.2 将脑组织置于70% (vol/vol) THF水溶液（pH 9–10）中振荡脱水。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

english.text: 6.2 Place the brain tissue in 70% (vol/vol) THF aqueous solution (pH 9–10) for oscillating dehydration. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

source.text: 6.3 将脑组织置于80% (vol/vol) THF水溶液（pH 9–10）中振荡脱水。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

english.text: 6.3 Place the brain tissue in 80% (vol/vol) THF aqueous solution (pH 9–10) for oscillating dehydration. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

source.text: 6.4 将脑组织置于100% THF（无水，pH 9–10，加少量NaOH）中振荡脱水，第一次。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

english.text: 6.4 Place the brain tissue in 100% THF (anhydrous, pH 9–10, with a small amount of NaOH added) for oscillating dehydration, first time. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

source.text: 6.5 将脑组织置于100% THF（无水，pH 9–10）中振荡脱水，第二次（更换新鲜THF）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

english.text: 6.5 Place the brain tissue in 100% THF (anhydrous, pH 9–10) for oscillating dehydration, second time (replace with fresh THF). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

source.text: **7 脱脂（BABB预处理）**

english.text: **7 De-lipidation (BABB Pre-treatment)**

source.text: 7.1 将脑组织置于BABB（苯甲醇:苯甲酸苄酯 = 1:2, vol/vol）中振荡，完成脱脂并开始RI匹配，直至组织完全透明（通常30–60 min）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

english.text: 7.1 Place the brain tissue in BABB (benzyl alcohol:benzyl benzoate = 1:2, vol/vol) with oscillation to complete de-lipidation and begin RI matching, until the tissue is completely transparent (usually 30–60 min). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

source.text: **8 折射率匹配（RI Matching）**

english.text: **8 Refractive Index Matching (RI Matching)**

source.text: 8.1 将透明脑组织转移至新鲜BABB（RI ≈ 1.56）中，避光静置平衡，确保组织完全透明且无气泡。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)

english.text: 8.1 Transfer the transparent brain tissue to fresh BABB (RI ≈ 1.56), let it stand protected from light to equilibrate, ensuring the tissue is completely transparent and free of bubbles. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)

source.text: 8.2 再次更换新鲜BABB，确认组织完全透明，准备成像。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 30 min)

english.text: 8.2 Replace with fresh BABB again, confirm the tissue is completely transparent, and prepare for imaging. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 30 min)

source.text: **9 成像前处理与保存**

english.text: **9 Pre-imaging Processing and Storage**

source.text: 9.1 将透明脑组织转移至适配光片显微镜样品槽的BABB中，使用折射率匹配的浸没介质（RI = 1.56）固定样品位置，避免气泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 即刻成像)

english.text: 9.1 Transfer the transparent brain tissue to BABB in a sample holder compatible with the light-sheet microscope sample slot, use a refractive index-matched immersion medium (RI = 1.56) to fix the sample position, and avoid bubbles. (Temperature: RT, Time: Immediate imaging)

source.text: 9.2 若需短期保存，将样品密封于BABB中，避光、4 ℃保存（建议1周内完成成像，以防荧光信号衰减）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: ≤ 7 days)

english.text: 9.2 If short-term storage is required, seal the sample in BABB and store protected from light at 4 ℃ (imaging is recommended to be completed within 1 week to prevent fluorescence signal decay). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: ≤ 7 days)

source.text: 101.1 将已4% PFA固定的成年小鼠全脑置于1× PBS中充分漂洗，去除残余固定液。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 × 1 hour)

english.text: 101.1 Place the adult mouse whole brain, already fixed in 4% PFA, in 1× PBS for thorough washing to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 × 1 hour)

source.text: **102 全脑免疫染色前渗透处理**

english.text: **102 Pre-permeabilization for Whole-Brain Immunostaining**

source.text: 102.1 将脑组织置于含0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100的1× PBS（PBST）中振荡渗透。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

english.text: 102.1 Place the brain tissue in 1× PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST) and agitate for permeabilization. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

source.text: 102.2 更换新鲜PBST继续渗透。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

english.text: 102.2 Replace with fresh PBST and continue permeabilization. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
**103 Blocking**

source.text: 103.1 将脑组织置于封闭液（5% (vol/vol) 正常驴血清 + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 0.1% (wt/vol) NaN₃ in 1× PBS）中振荡封闭。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

english.text: 103.1 Place the brain tissue in blocking solution (5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 0.1% (wt/vol) NaN₃ in 1× PBS) and agitate for blocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

source.text: **104 一抗孵育（β-III Tubulin / TUJ1）**

english.text: **104 Primary Antibody Incubation (β-III Tubulin / TUJ1)**

source.text: 104.1 将脑组织置于含抗β-III Tubulin（TUJ1）兔多克隆抗体（1:500稀释于封闭液）的溶液中，轻柔振荡孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

english.text: 104.1 Place the brain tissue in a solution containing anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) rabbit polyclonal antibody (diluted 1:500 in blocking solution) and incubate with gentle agitation. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

source.text: 104.2 用PBST洗涤，去除未结合一抗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

english.text: 104.2 Wash with PBST to remove unbound primary antibody. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

source.text: **105 二抗孵育（Alexa Fluor 647）**

english.text: **105 Secondary Antibody Incubation (Alexa Fluor 647)**

source.text: 105.1 将脑组织置于含驴抗兔 Alexa Fluor 647二抗（1:500稀释于封闭液）的溶液中，避光振荡孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

english.text: 105.1 Place the brain tissue in a solution containing donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 secondary antibody (diluted 1:500 in blocking solution) and incubate with agitation protected from light. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

source.text: 105.2 用PBST洗涤，去除未结合二抗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

english.text: 105.2 Wash with PBST to remove unbound secondary antibody. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

source.text: 105.3 用1× PBS终洗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

english.text: 105.3 Final wash with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

source.text: **106 脱水（THF梯度脱水）**

english.text: **106 Dehydration (THF Gradient Dehydration)**

source.text: 106.1 将脑组织置于50% (vol/vol) THF（四氢呋喃）水溶液（用NaOH调pH至9–10，以保护荧光蛋白）中振荡脱水。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

english.text: 106.1 Place the brain tissue in 50% (vol/vol) THF (tetrahydrofuran) aqueous solution (adjust pH to 9–10 with NaOH to protect fluorescent proteins) and agitate for dehydration. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

source.text: 106.2 将脑组织置于70% (vol/vol) THF水溶液（pH 9–10）中振荡脱水。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

english.text: 106.2 Place the brain tissue in 70% (vol/vol) THF aqueous solution (pH 9–10) and agitate for dehydration. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

source.text: 106.3 将脑组织置于80% (vol/vol) THF水溶液（pH 9–10）中振荡脱水。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

english.text: 106.3 Place the brain tissue in 80% (vol/vol) THF aqueous solution (pH 9–10) and agitate for dehydration. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

source.text: 106.4 将脑组织置于100% THF（无水，pH 9–10，加少量NaOH）中振荡脱水，第一次。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

english.text: 106.4 Place the brain tissue in 100% THF (anhydrous, pH 9–10, add a small amount of NaOH) and agitate for dehydration, first time. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

source.text: 106.5 将脑组织置于100% THF（无水，pH 9–10）中振荡脱水，第二次（更换新鲜THF）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

english.text: 106.5 Place the brain tissue in 100% THF (anhydrous, pH 9–10) and agitate for dehydration, second time (replace with fresh THF). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

source.text: **107 脱脂（BABB预处理）**

english.text: **107 Delipidation (BABB Pre-treatment)**

source.text: 107.1 将脑组织置于BABB（苯甲醇:苯甲酸苄酯 = 1:2, vol/vol）中振荡，完成脱脂并开始RI匹配，直至组织完全透明（通常30–60 min）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

english.text: 107.1 Place the brain tissue in BABB (benzyl alcohol:benzyl benzoate = 1:2, vol/vol) and agitate to complete delipidation and begin RI matching, until the tissue is completely transparent (usually 30–60 min). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

source.text: **108 折射率匹配（RI Matching）**

english.text: **108 Refractive Index Matching (RI Matching)**

source.text: 108.1 将透明脑组织转移至新鲜BABB（RI ≈ 1.56）中，避光静置平衡，确保组织完全透明且无气泡。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)

english.text: 108.1 Transfer the transparent brain tissue to fresh BABB (RI ≈ 1.56) and let it stand protected from light to equilibrate, ensuring the tissue is completely transparent and free of bubbles. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)

source.text: 108.2 再次更换新鲜BABB，确认组织完全透明，准备成像。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 30 min)

english.text: 108.2 Replace with fresh BABB again, confirm the tissue is completely transparent, and prepare for imaging. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 30 min)

source.text: **109 成像前处理与保存**

english.text: **109 Pre-imaging Processing and Storage**

source.text: 109.1 将透明脑组织转移至适配光片显微镜样品槽的BABB中，使用折射率匹配的浸没介质（RI = 1.56）固定样品位置，避免气泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 即刻成像)

english.text: 109.1 Transfer the transparent brain tissue to BABB in a sample holder compatible with the light-sheet microscope sample slot. Use a refractive index-matched immersion medium (RI = 1.56) to fix the sample position, avoiding bubbles. (Temperature: RT, Time: Immediate imaging)

source.text: 109.2 若需短期保存，将样品密封于BABB中，避光、4 ℃保存（建议1周内完成成像，以防荧光信号衰减）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: ≤ 7 days)

english.text: 109.2 If short-term storage is required, seal the sample in BABB and store protected from light at 4 ℃ (imaging is recommended to be completed within 1 week to prevent fluorescence signal decay). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: ≤ 7 days)

source.text:
**Chosen Method:** FDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato (内源荧光), β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor (647)]
**Justification:** FDISCO（Fluorescence-preserved 3D Imaging of Solvent-Cleared Organs）是基于有机溶剂的快速透明方法，全脑透明可在约2天内完成，满足"尽快成像"的需求，且相比iDISCO+/uDISCO对荧光蛋白保护更佳（低温+碱性条件抑制荧光淬灭），已有文献证明可良好保留tdTomato内源信号。FDISCO使用THF脱水/脱脂后以BABB作为RI匹配液（RI≈1.56），与光片显微镜兼容，可接受一定程度的组织收缩（FDISCO收缩率约35–40%，均匀收缩不影响投射追踪）。标记策略：①保留tdTomato内源荧光追踪长程投射神经元；②在透明前对固定脑进行全脑免疫染色（iDISCO-style whole-mount），使用抗β-III Tubulin（TUJ1）抗体 + Alexa Fluor 647二抗标记轴突骨架结构，Alexa Fluor 647在有机溶剂中稳定性优异。两通道（tdTomato ~590 nm；AF647 ~647 nm）光谱分离良好，适合双通道光片成像。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

english.text:
**Chosen Method:** FDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato (endogenous fluorescence), β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor (647)]
**Justification:** FDISCO (Fluorescence-preserved 3D Imaging of Solvent-Cleared Organs) is a rapid clearing method based on organic solvents. Whole-brain clearing can be completed in approximately 2 days, meeting the requirement for "imaging as soon as possible." It offers better protection of fluorescent proteins compared to iDISCO+/uDISCO (low temperature + alkaline conditions inhibit fluorescence quenching), and literature has demonstrated that it can well preserve endogenous tdTomato signals. FDISCO uses THF for dehydration/de-lipidation and BABB as the RI matching medium (RI ≈ 1.56), which is compatible with light-sheet microscopy and accepts a certain degree of tissue shrinkage (FDISCO shrinkage rate is approximately 35–40%; uniform shrinkage does not affect projection tracing). Labeling strategy: ① Preserve endogenous tdTomato fluorescence to trace long-range projection neurons; ② Perform whole-brain immunostaining (iDISCO-style whole-mount) on the fixed brain prior to clearing, using anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) antibody + Alexa Fluor 647 secondary antibody to label axonal skeleton structures. Alexa Fluor 647 has excellent stability in organic solvents. The two channels (tdTomato ~590 nm; AF647 ~647 nm) have good spectral separation, suitable for dual-channel light-sheet imaging.

---

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato (内源荧光), β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor (647)]
**Justification:** FDISCO（Fluorescence-preserved 3D Imaging of Solvent-Cleared Organs）是基于有机溶剂的快速透明方法，全脑透明可在约2天内完成，满足"尽快成像"的需求，且相比iDISCO+/uDISCO对荧光蛋白保护更佳（低温+碱性条件抑制荧光淬灭），已有文献证明可良好保留tdTomato内源信号。FDISCO使用THF脱水/脱脂后以BABB作为RI匹配液（RI≈1.56），与光片显微镜兼容，可接受一定程度的组织收缩（FDISCO收缩率约35–40%，均匀收缩不影响投射追踪）。标记策略：①保留tdTomato内源荧光追踪长程投射神经元；②在透明前对固定脑进行全脑免疫染色（iDISCO-style whole-mount），使用抗β-III Tubulin（TUJ1）抗体 + Alexa Fluor 647二抗标记轴突骨架结构，Alexa Fluor 647在有机溶剂中稳定性优异。两通道（tdTomato ~590 nm；AF647 ~647 nm）光谱分离良好，适合双通道光片成像。

---

english.text:
**Chosen Method:** FDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato (endogenous fluorescence), β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor (647)]
**Justification:** FDISCO (Fluorescence-preserved 3D Imaging of Solvent-Cleared Organs) is a rapid clearing method based on organic solvents. Whole-brain clearing can be completed in approximately 2 days, meeting the requirement for "imaging as soon as possible." It offers better protection of fluorescent proteins compared to iDISCO+/uDISCO (low temperature + alkaline conditions inhibit fluorescence quenching), and literature has demonstrated that it can well preserve endogenous tdTomato signals. FDISCO uses THF for dehydration/de-lipidation and BABB as the RI matching medium (RI≈1.56), which is compatible with light-sheet microscopy and accepts a certain degree of tissue shrinkage (FDISCO shrinkage rate is approximately 35–40%; uniform shrinkage does not affect projection tracing). Labeling strategy: ① Preserve endogenous tdTomato fluorescence to trace long-range projection neurons; ② Perform whole-brain immunostaining (iDISCO-style whole-mount) on the fixed brain prior to clearing, using anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) antibody + Alexa Fluor 647 secondary antibody to label axonal skeleton structures. Alexa Fluor 647 has excellent stability in organic solvents. The two channels (tdTomato ~590 nm; AF647 ~647 nm) have good spectral separation, suitable for dual-channel light-sheet imaging.

---
